content.content: The user asks: "Who is the oldest current serving member of the US Supreme Court?" Need to answer with the name. Need up-to-date info as of now (2025-11-01). As of 2023, the oldest was Justice Clarence Thomas (born June 23, 1948). However there is also Justice Samuel Alito (born April 1, 1950) younger. Actually Thomas is older. But also Justice Neil Gorsuch (born Aug 29, 1967). So the oldest is Thomas. However we should verify if any new appointments changed. As of 2025, the composition: Chief Justice John Roberts (born 1955), Justice Clarence Thomas (1948), Justice Samuel Alito (1950), Justice Sonia Sotomayor (1954), Justice Elena Kagan (1960), Justice Neil Gorsuch (1967), Justice Brett Kavanaugh (1965), Justice Amy Coney Barrett (1972), Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson (1970). So Thomas remains oldest. Should confirm via search.

The oldest currently‑serving Justice on the United States Supreme Court is **Associate Justice Clarence Thomas**.  

- **Date of birth:** June 23 1948 (Pin Point, Georgia)  
- **Age as of November 2025:** 77 years old  
- **Service on the Court:** Nominated by President George H. W. Bush and has served since October 23 1991.  

Since Justice Stephen Breyer’s retirement in 2022, Justice Thomas has been the Court’s senior‑by‑age member. No newer appointee is older than him.
